title: Language-Driven Opinion Dynamics in Agent-Based Simulations with LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating multi-agent interactions using the LODAS framework to track opinion evolution over time, specifically measuring LLM agents' acceptance rates and strong tendencies to converge on agreement with presented statements regardless of balanced, polarized, or unbalanced initial opinion distributions.

Employing a transformer-based classifier (distilbert-base-fallacy-classification) to detect the use of logical fallacies (such as fallacies of relevance, credibility, and appeal to emotion) in agent-generated arguments, and quantifying how frequently these flawed arguments successfully persuade opposing agents to change their stance.
